endpoints.name: CreateFactory
endpoints.business_purpose: Create a new factory record with name, description, address, and phone number.

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates new factory record. Validates factory name uniqueness. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Factory name required and must be unique.
business_logic.validations: ModelState valid. Factory name non-empty and unique.
business_logic.side_effects: Audit log created. User tracked in context.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: Factory with this name already exists.
message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

idempotency.notes: Name uniqueness check means repeated calls fail. Recommend idempotency key on client.

endpoints.short_description: Create a new factory record with name, description, address, and phone number.
endpoints.detailed_description: Create a new factory record with name, description, address, and phone number. It validates the request, then checks for an existing/duplicate record, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IFactory.IsFactoryNameDuplicateAsync, IFactory.CreateFactoryAsync, then writes an audit log entry. Persists changes to: Factories: INSERT, AuditLog: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.validation_errors: 400: Invalid data provided. [when !ModelState.IsValid]; Factory name is required. [when string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(request.factoryName)]; message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)
error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No token provided. [when current_user == null]
error_handling.business_rule_errors: Factory with this name already exists. [when dupcheck]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create a new factory record with name, description, address, and phone number.
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

endpoints.name: UpdateFactory
endpoints.business_purpose: Update existing factory details (name, description, address, phone).

business_logic.operation_summary: Updates existing factory record. Validates name uniqueness (excluding current ID). Creates audit log with old/new values.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Factory ID > 0. Factory must exist. At least one field must be provided.
business_logic.validations: Factory ID > 0. Factory exists. Factory name unique (excluding current). At least one field provided.
business_logic.side_effects: Audit log created with old and new values.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: At least one field (factoryName or Description) must be provided for update.
Factory with this name already exists.
message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

idempotency.notes: Name uniqueness check per ID reduces risk. Audit log tracks changes.

endpoints.name: DeleteFactory

business_logic.operation_summary: Soft deletes factory record by setting is_deleted flag. Creates audit log.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Factory ID > 0. Factory must exist.
business_logic.side_effects: Audit log created. Factory marked as deleted.
business_logic.state_changes: Factories: UPDATE; soft delete (is_deleted flag); AuditLog: INSERT
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

validation_rules.message: message returned by the called service/repository (result.Message)

idempotency.notes: Repeated DELETE calls fail once deleted. Audit log needed for idempotency detection.
